This is an established but non-trivial computational workflow in condensed matter physics; reproducing the LDOS periodicity tests whether the hybridization is captured correctly, demanding a solid understanding of DFT settings and supercell geometry.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves geometry optimizations of two separate supercells, building a bilayer model, a spin-polarized SCF calculation, and a non-self-consistent LDOS computation on a plane. That is a multi-stage DFT workflow with dependencies and requires using an external code like Quantum ESPRESSO, proper input setup, and handling of convergence. The orchestration is moderate (4-5 stages), not trivial but not extremely fragile.
